product_overview: Innvator Core is a comprehensive, multi-tenant hotel management system designed to streamline operations including reservations, dynamic pricing, maintenance, financial reporting, and channel management through OTA integrations. It delivers a rich dashboard with real-time occupancy and detailed analytics to optimize hotel performance.
core_goals: Provide a robust reservation system with real-time availability and flexible pricing.
Enable dynamic pricing with seasons, promotions, and pricing rules.
Offer a full maintenance ticket system with prioritization and room status integration.
Deliver interactive and detailed financial reports for revenue, payments, and OTA performance.
Implement a channel manager to synchronize availability and rates across OTAs.
Ensure multi-tenant support with strict data isolation by establishment.
Implement role-based access control to secure and tailor user operations.
key_features: Authentication system with Supabase Auth including role and route protection.
Multi-tenant architecture managing companies, establishments, and isolation per establishment.
Reservation management with creation, editing, check-in/out, cancellation, and advanced calendar views.
Room management covering rooms, categories, buildings with status and availability.
Client management with full CRUD of guest information and documents.
Real-time occupancy map showing room and reservation statuses.
Dynamic pricing engine managing seasons, pricing plans, rules, and promotions.
Channel manager with OTA integrations for Booking, Airbnb, Expedia including synchronization and channel-specific pricing.
Comprehensive financial reports showing revenue, payment methods, cash flow, and channel comparisons.
Maintenance management system with ticket creation, status tracking, priority, and assignment.
User and employee management with granular role-based permissions and access controls.
Settings module for hotel info, schedules, payment methods, and API integrations.
User profile management for personal data, email, and password updates.
user_flow_summary: User logs in via authentication system with role-based route protection.
User selects an establishment within their company context due to multi-tenancy.
User creates or edits reservations using a validated form that checks room availability and calculates dynamic pricing including any applied promotions.
User manages room inventory including categories and building information to ensure correct availability.
Maintenance staff or managers log, assign, and update maintenance tickets that integrate with room statuses, preventing conflicts with reservations.
Finance managers view interactive dashboards and reports that detail revenue, payments, and OTA channel performance with export options.
Admins configure pricing seasons, rules, and promotions to influence reservation pricing dynamically.
Channel manager users configure OTA channels, synchronize availability, import reservations and adjust channel pricing.
Users access dashboards presenting key hotel metrics including occupancy, recent reservations, and financial summaries.
User and employee management flows ensure proper role assignments and access control.
Users update their profile information securely with validation and authentication.
validation_criteria: Reservation forms validate date ranges, room availability, and client data before submission.
Pricing calculations dynamically update on date changes and promotion applications, matching backend logic.
Maintenance tickets correctly update room statuses and prevent reservation conflicts.
Financial reports display accurate data fetched from Supabase with interactive charts and exportable reports.
Channel manager syncs OTA data correctly and maintains consistent pricing and availability.
Role-based controls restrict access to features and navigation per user permission levels.
Multi-tenant data isolation guarantees data privacy between companies and establishments.
Dashboard metrics correspond to real-time data, displaying consistent occupancy and revenue info.
Error handling and loading states are present across features for reliable UX.
All user inputs are validated on frontend and backend for security and data integrity.
